notes.title: A New Update for Inmates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to share with you that we just released a new patch for Inmates. Version 1.0.2 fixes some minor issues that were reported by the community and has a couple of graphical improvements. More importantly however, we fixed some FPS issues for low-spec machines and we added some new sounds and an additional scare (can you find it?).

Thank you all for your feedback, it is much appreciated, so please continue to let us know what you think of the game and updates.

- Surtur


Changelog:

Version 1.0.2
18.10.2017

Update list.

- Some minor graphical updates
- Fix some minor bugs
- Fix FPS drop down on low spec computers
- Add new sounds 
- Add some new creepiness

Version 1.0.1
10.10.2017

- Increase lighting 
- Increase walk speed
- Some minor graphical updates
- Remove animated blurry effect in some levels
- Fix some minor bugs

Cancel your therapist, draw a disturbing childhood piece to win a unique prize! We are thrilled to invite all horror fans to participate in our special Inmates contest.

[h1]Enter the contest [url=http://www.iceberg-games.com/inmatescontest]here[/url][/h1]

We have two hand-made physical copies of Anton’s in-game diary, and you can win one! In return, we need you to revisit your childhood, and ruin it just a tiny little bit.

Get creative and draw your best ‘messed up children’s style drawing’ for us. Together with [url=http://www.relyonhorror.com]Rely on Horror[/url], we’ll be picking the two lucky winners that will receive Anton’s Diary and a copy of the game.

notes.title: ICEBERG INTERACTIVE ANNOUNCES PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR GAME ‘INMATES’
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30427573/ac6ebb5b4ae4c7cd696fcaab5bfb5e35f244389f.jpg[/img]

Haarlem, The Netherlands – Publisher Iceberg Interactive and developer Davit Andreasyan announce Inmates, a new psychological horror game with puzzle elements for PC. In Inmates, you must discover the truth behind your confinement and discover the dark secrets of the run-down prison you find yourself in.

Inmates is set for a release within the next few months on Steam and other digital retailers, at a price point of $9.99. In anticipation of the release, an announcement trailer has been released that gives players a sense of the terror they will experience. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=96xo2hED6l8&feature=youtu.be]Watch the trailer here[/url]

The most disturbing thing about Jonathan’s nightmare is that he may not be dreaming. 

You’ve awoken from a nightmare, Jonathan. But did it truly end? You are in a run-down prison cell and have no clue how you got there. You’re terrified and confused, but you also feel something else: a painful sense of familiarity.

You’ve convinced yourself this is all just a nightmare. Unfortunately, according to the voice coming from the old radio, things are not as simple as you’d like them to be.

Discover the truth behind your predicament while trying to stay sane, in this most disturbing of horror games.

Features 
•	Interact with the environment to unravel the truth
•	Intense and mind-bending puzzles
•	Suffocating setting
•	Disturbing imagery
•	High-quality graphics powered by Unreal Engine 4
•	Full controller support
•	Estimated game length: 3-4 hours
